layers: vLLM host-to-device staging: CpuGpuBuffer.copy_to_gpu (vllm/v1/utils.py) copies through fresh pinned memory, so a pinned host buffer rewritten for the next step while its copy is still queued under async scheduling cannot change the copied data. Without it, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with MTP speculative decoding, async scheduling and FULL CUDA graphs turned about 0.2-0.5% of concurrent requests into NaN state that decoded as token 8191 repeated (FujitsuPolycom/sparkring#294); /opt/sparkring/receipts/derived-staging-fix.json records the replaced file
